# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary and language reference since 1847, founded on Noah Webster's pioneering lexicography work.

Merriam-Webster provides comprehensive dictionary, thesaurus, and word game tools, continuing the legacy of Noah Webster and the G. & C. Merriam Co. established in Springfield, Massachusetts. The site offers both free resources and premium products like the Merriam-Webster Unabridged dictionary.

## Core Dictionary & Language Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble word finder tool to unscramble letters and solve word games
- [About the Unabridged](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/info/about-the-unabridged.html): Overview of Merriam-Webster Unabridged dictionary features
- [Browse Dictionary - Letter A (page 2)](https://merriam-webster.com/browse/dictionary/a/2): Dictionary browse page for words starting with A, page 2
- [Browse Thesaurus - Letter A (page 2)](https://merriam-webster.com/browse/thesaurus/a/2): Browse thesaurus entries starting with letter A, page 2
